_comment: Single source of truth for figure colours. Read by Python (site_palette.py) and MATLAB (sitePalette.m). These values mirror the CSS custom properties in style.css, so a figure dropped into a page sits on the same surface as the page itself instead of punching a white rectangle into it. If style.css changes, change this file and re-run the figure scripts.
_series_comment: Categorical slots in fixed order, never cycled. Assign slot 1 first, then 2, and so on. Adjacent pairs are separated in hue and lightness so they survive colour-vision deficiency.
_reference_comment: Measured or ground-truth data uses the neutral; the thing being argued for uses the page accent. One series is the point, the other is context.
